title: lily
description: This modpack adds animations, visual effects, and sounds. It's a mix of what the Minecraft trailer looks like and Action & Staff.
body:
# 🎯 Purpose:
The purpose of this modpack is to add a variety of animations, sounds, visual effects, and simply create a beautiful and minimalistic visual. Another goal was to create a modpack for servers, so it can be played on SMP servers. 
## ❗ REMARK:
This modpack does not include voice chat mods:
- [Plasmo Voice](https://modrinth.com/plugin/plasmo-voice)
- [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat)

# 🖋️ P.S:
Although this modpack was originally intended for personal use, after some consideration, I decided to publish it. Before using this or similar modpacks, it is recommended that you consult with your server moderators to ensure that the modpack's content is permitted.
I've seen a few modpacks that tried to recreate Action & Staff and Minecraft from the trailers in one modpack, but there were very few of them. So I think this modpack is quite rare in its kind :3. I can also add that this modpack is suitable for those who want to combine Bare Bone and Action & Staff.
